errorMessage:
A sequence number occurs more than once in the same session.
SELECT sequence_number, COUNT(*) AS affected_sessions
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, sequence_number
  FROM `tv_thelook.events`
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-04 00:00:00+00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05 00:00:00+00'
    AND session_id IS NOT NULL
    AND sequence_number IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY session_id, sequence_number
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
GROUP BY sequence_number
ORDER BY sequence_number
LIMIT 100
